issue_request: FHIR-25454 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested changing the R4 CareTeam example name from "Peter James Charlmers Care Plan for Inpatient Encounter" to "Peter James Charlmers Care Team for Inpatient Encounter".

Pickaxe history confirms that commit removed the old phrase and introduced the requested replacement.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini and CareTeam/example is listed in source/careteam/list-CareTeam-examples.xml, so the inspected XML is current build input. FHIR-25453, mentioned in the issue as CarePlan context, was resolved Not Persuasive and does not require extra source edits. A Confluence reference points to the 2020-01-23 Patient Care minutes page, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/careteam/careteam-example.xml already has both its generated narrative and CareTeam.name using "Care Team" rather than "Care Plan".
